findings.summary: Block not substantiated against the packet's documented credential path. The constraint provisions an isolated empty user (gddp-part1@local on khoj-38-b) with a token at /home/sab-mini/.khoj/gddp-part1.token on the VM and explicitly directs reading it via ssh. The report/handoff never record attempting that path (no mention of gddp-part1 or the token file anywhere in the worktree), even though the executor had VM access (systemctl/service-command probes). The report instead concludes credentials 'were not supplied by the packet' — mischaracterizing the packet, which deliberately keeps the token on the VM — and its evidence only probes the anonymous default@example.com surface, which confirms the packet's warning about that user but says nothing about the isolated gddp-part1@local corpus the packet states was verified empty. Per the 'record precisely what blocked and stop' constraint, the stop needed either a recorded token-path failure (file absent, user unreachable) or a Bearer-authenticated probe of the isolated user's corpus; neither exists. The node's intended role (Stage F: load the snapshot into a clean corpus) was therefore abandoned on an unsubstantiated premise.

Attempt 2 (commit 31c1ead) is an empty commit identical in tree to attempt 0 (1f47c39): the block was re-affirmed without any new probing of the isolated-user credential path, so the gap persisted across the retry.

The correct behavior per the 'record precisely what blocked' constraint was to record a concrete token-path failure (file absent, user unreachable, or Bearer-auth probe of gddp-part1@local showing non-empty/unreachable); that evidence is absent. This is a subtle veer from the node's role: a defensible stop-and-record that does not substantiate the stop it claims, and whose retry (attempt 2) added no new evidence. A human must verify whether /home/sab-mini/.khoj/gddp-part1.token exists on khoj-38-b and whether gddp-part1@local is reachable with Bearer auth before any dependent fires; if the token exists, node-08 should be re-run to actually ingest.
